category_a_business.overview: Target Corporation은 미국에서 일반 상품 소매업체로 운영되고 있습니다. 여성, 남성, 청소년, 어린이, 유아, 유아용 의류는 물론 보석, 액세서리, 신발도 제공합니다. 피부 및 목욕 케어, 화장품, 헤어 케어, 구강 케어, 탈취제 및 면도 제품과 같은 미용 제품. 또한 회사는 스낵, 사탕, 음료, 델리, 베이커리, 육류, 농산물 및 식품 서비스를 포함하여 건조하고 부패하기 쉬운 식료품으로 구성된 식품 및 음료 제품을 제공합니다. 비디오 게임 및 콘솔, 장난감, 스포츠 용품, 엔터테인먼트 및 수하물을 포함하는 전자 제품; 침대
category_a_business.business_model: Target Corporation operates as a general merchandise retailer in the United States.
products: as a general merchandise retailer in the United States
apparel for women, men, young adults, kids, toddlers, and babies, as well as jewelry, accessories, and shoes
food and beverage products comprising dry and perishable grocery, including snacks, candy, beverages, deli, bakery, meat
merchandise through periodic design and creative partnerships, and shop-in-shop experience
category_a_business.wikipedia_excerpt: Target Corporation is an American retail corporation headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States. Target operates small-format and large-format retail stores and hypermarkets. It is the eighth-largest retailer in the U.S. and a component of the S&P 500 Index.

top_risks.description: The following risks, some of which have occurred and any of which may occur in the future, could materially and adversely affect our business and financial performance.
These are not the only risks we face and there may be other risks that could materially and adversely affect our business and financial performance.
Competitive and Reputational Risks If we are unable to positively differentiate ourselves from our competitors, our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.
If we fail to differentiate our guest experience from our competitors, our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.
Since consumers can quickly comparison shop using digital tools, they may make decisions based solely on price or convenience, which could limit our ability to differentiate from our competitors.
If we are unable to offset our investments in these or other initiatives with improved performance or efficiencies, our results of operations could be adversely affected.
